# Test-validation PIR script for the desktop (native) build.
#
# DO NOT EDIT: the CLAUDE.md test procedure's expected PIR-test colors are
# keyed to the exact iterations in this file. For experiments, edit
# lib/mock-arduino/script.txt (the gitignored default) instead.
#
# Format:  <iteration> <15-char PIR string>
# Each digit is one panel:  0 = none, 1 = front, 2 = back, 3 = both.
# Values hold until the next entry. Iteration is millis() in the mock,
# which advances by 1 per loop().
#
# Select this file with the AUNISOMA_MOCK_SCRIPT environment variable.
